title: 雅思听力 · Section 4 城市蜜蜂研究（讲座填空）

questions.stem: City bees can be more ______ than bees in the countryside.
questions.explain: 原文：bees in cities can be more productive than bees in the surrounding countryside —— productive。
questions.transcript: Several studies in Europe and North America have found that bees in cities can be more productive than bees in the surrounding countryside.

questions.stem: Cities are usually warmer by ______ degrees.
questions.explain: 原文：often by two or three degrees —— 2–3 度。
questions.transcript: Cities are warmer than the countryside, often by two or three degrees, because buildings and roads store heat during the day and release it at night.

questions.stem: A longer flowering season means more time to ______.
questions.explain: 原文：a longer season means more time to collect food —— collect food。
questions.transcript: A warmer city means a longer flowering season, and a longer season means more time to collect food.

questions.stem: Second reason: the ______ of plants available in a city.
questions.explain: 原文：The second reason is variety. A garden, a park and a railway embankment may each hold different plants —— variety。
questions.transcript: The second reason is variety. A garden, a park and a railway embankment may each hold different plants, and a single city can therefore offer flowers over a longer period than a large field of one crop.

questions.stem: Third reason: the absence of ______ in city gardens.
questions.explain: 原文：The third reason is the absence of pesticides. Farmland is treated, but city gardens usually are not —— pesticides。
questions.transcript: The third reason is the absence of pesticides. Farmland is treated, but city gardens usually are not.

questions.stem: In city centres there has been a sharp fall in the number of ______ species.
questions.explain: 原文：The same studies show a sharp fall in the number of butterfly species in city centres —— butterfly。
questions.transcript: The same studies show a sharp fall in the number of butterfly species in city centres.

questions.stem: Butterflies need large ______ areas of a particular plant.
questions.explain: 原文：Butterflies need large continuous areas of a particular plant, and cities are fragmented —— continuous。与 fragmented 构成反义提示。
questions.transcript: Butterflies need large continuous areas of a particular plant, and cities are fragmented.

questions.stem: Counting honey is limited because it tells us about ______ species only.
questions.explain: 原文：Counting the honey produced by a hive is convenient, but it tells us about one species only —— one。
questions.transcript: Counting the honey produced by a hive is convenient, but it tells us about one species only.

questions.explain: 原文：we need to count wild species as well, and that is much slower work —— wild。
questions.transcript: If we want to know whether a city is good for pollinators in general, we need to count wild species as well, and that is much slower work.

questions.stem: Main lesson: different insects respond to different features, so a city can be a refuge for one group and a ______ for another.
questions.explain: 原文：a city can be a refuge for one group while it is a barrier for another —— barrier。与 refuge 对举，是讲座的核心结论。
questions.transcript: The lesson is that different insects respond to different features of the landscape, and that a city can be a refuge for one group while it is a barrier for another.
